text: Teaching Objectives After graduation you will be qualified senior and comprehensive engineering technicians in the areas of production technology and research, engineering construction, industrial enterprises trade, and administrative management and training and so forth. Main Courses Advanced Mathematics, College English, Principle and Applications of Computer, Mechanical Drawing, Engineering Mechanics, Electrical and Electronic Technology, Theory of Machines and Mechanisms, Mechanic, Engineering Control, Electromechanical integration Technology, Hydraulic Transmission, Mechanical CAD/CAM, Equipment Design, Technology of Mechanical Manufacture, CNC Technology, Single Chip and PLC Technology. Study Duration 4 years. Degree Awarded With necessary credits, those who have passed all the required courses and met the requirements for graduation of the university will be awarded bachelor's degree and diploma. Career Opportunity Graduates will be capable to work in mechanical and traffic institutions, colleges, companies, focus on varies mechanical and electrical products or electromechanical device’s research, design, manufacture, development, administration and so on. Notes: Program commences only if 15 students are enrolled ; otherwise you can study Chinese Language/ Pre- University Program/ other bachelor programs.
